name: NMR jsGrid
author: mirceatm

sections.description:
Add jsGrid http://js-grid.com tables to your website using the shortcode: [nmr_jsgrid id='your-grid-name'].

Data grids or tables have configurable columns, filters, edit, update and delete functionality.
Configuration is performed in the WordPress admin. Tables support AJAX pagination to avoid full page reloads.

This is the free version of NMR jsGrid. For unlimited grids and all features, see NMR jsGrid Pro.

Free version limits

  • Maximum 10 grids
  • select field type is read-only in the column editor (Pro only)
  • Build Columns from Data Source is disabled (Pro only)

Pro version

NMR jsGrid Pro adds:

  • Unlimited grids
  • select field type with custom items, value field, and text field
  • Build Columns from Data Source — auto-detect columns from SQL, static, or remote data
  • Priority support

Usage

Build and configure grids in Admin → NMR jsGrid. Choose a data source type (Remote, Static, or SQL), define columns, and embed with the shortcode.
Please consult the jsGrid documentation for full field reference.

  • Name — used as the DOM id for the grid and in the shortcode
  • URL — (Remote source) back-end endpoint, usually https://your-site.com/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php
  • Action — (Remote source) synchronized with back-end action name, e.g. sample_pagination from wp_ajax_nopriv_sample_pagination
  • Fields — column definitions. Example: [{"name":"umeta_id","title":"Id","type":"number"},{"name":"meta_key","title":"Key","type":"text"}]
    Available types (free): text, number, checkbox, textarea, date, control
  • Height — auto, percent (80%), or pixels (400)
  • Width — same as Height
  • Paging, Editing, Sorting, Autoload, Deleting, Filtering, Inserting, Page size — self-explanatory grid options
  • Pager format — e.g. Rows: {itemCount} - Pages: {first} {prev} {pages} {next} {last}    {pageIndex} of {pageCount}
  • Page buttons — number of page buttons shown (5 is a good default)

Data source types

  • Remote — AJAX calls to a custom WordPress action you provide
  • Static — inline JSON array
  • SQL — direct SQL SELECT query; the plugin handles pagination, filtering, insert, update, delete automatically

Enqueue in admin

To use grids in your own admin pages, add the page hook to the filter:

add_filter('nmr_jsgrid_admin_enqueue_scripts', function ($hooks) {
    $hooks[] = 'admin-my_page_admin-my_subpage';
    return $hooks;
});

If you enjoy using NMR jsGrid and find it useful, please consider making a donation.

Privacy Notices
sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire nmr-jsgrid folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
